newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Cabinet approves urban renewal regulations; may form company with private sector for urban development
-- Democratic Progressive Party National Assembly caucus reaches consensus on constitutional amendments with Nationalist Party
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Vaccine against B-type hepatitis can help prevent liver cancer
-- Taiwan's state-run China Shipbuilding wins T$5.5 billion bid to build 11 patrol vessels for navy
LIBERTY TIMES - Support for provincial government wanes under persistent Nationalist Party persuasion
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Thailand listed by foreign banks as high-risk area
-- Central bank mulls funds injection in banking system to ease tight liquidity
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan may tighten local investment in Hong Kong
-- Short-term paper rates skyrocket to 10 percent
